# Pikabu
> Russian social content platform for user-generated posts, comments, communities, and topic-based discovery.

Pikabu combines a large social feed with themed communities, ranking pages, and several adjacent services such as jobs, education, games, and advertising resources. The platform is primarily Russian-language and centers on browsing, voting, discussing, and discovering popular posts.

## Main Feeds
- [Горячее](https://pikabu.ru/): Main feed of trending and actively discussed posts across the platform.
- [Лучшее](https://pikabu.ru/best): Top-rated posts selected by community voting and engagement.
- [Свежее](https://pikabu.ru/new): Chronological feed of newly published user posts and media.
- [Подписки](https://pikabu.ru/subs): Personalized feed from authors, tags, and communities a user follows.

## Discovery
- [Темы](https://pikabu.ru/themes): Directory of topics and tags for browsing posts by subject.
- [Сообщества](https://pikabu.ru/communities): Catalog of user communities organized around interests and formats.
- [Эксперты](https://pikabu.ru/experts): Expert-oriented area highlighting recognized authors and specialized content.
- [Лучшее за неделю](https://pikabu.ru/best/week): Weekly ranking of the most popular posts on Pikabu.
- [Лучшее за месяц](https://pikabu.ru/best/month): Monthly ranking page for high-performing posts and stories.

## Community and Participation
- [Лига Авторов](https://pikabu.ru/community/author): Community space for authors, posting culture, and creator discussions.
- [Рейтинг пользователей](https://pikabu.ru/rating): User ranking page based on platform activity and reputation.
- [Комментарии](https://pikabu.ru/comments): Stream or entry point for comment-focused discussion activity.
- [Пикабу Помощь](https://pikabu.ru/community/support): Community area for support questions and platform-related help.

## Platform Information
- [Правила](https://pikabu.ru/information/rules): Official platform rules governing content, behavior, and moderation.
- [Помощь](https://pikabu.ru/information/help): Help center with answers about accounts, posting, and site features.
- [О проекте](https://pikabu.ru/information/about): Overview of Pikabu, its purpose, and general platform information.
- [Конфиденциальность](https://pikabu.ru/information/privacy): Privacy policy describing personal data handling and protection.
- [Согласие на обработку ПД](https://pikabu.ru/information/consent): Personal data processing consent used during registration and service use.
- [Пользовательское соглашение](https://pikabu.ru/information/agreement): Terms governing use of the platform and user responsibilities.

## Advertising and Business
- [Медиакит](https://special.pikabu.ru/mediakit): Advertising presentation with audience metrics, formats, and partnership options.
- [Реклама на Пикабу](https://special.pikabu.ru/): Business-facing landing pages for brand placements and campaigns.
- [Партнерские спецпроекты](https://special.pikabu.ru/projects): Showcase of branded and special advertising projects on Pikabu.

## Jobs
- [Вакансии](https://vacancies.pikabu.ru/): Job board with listings across regions, roles, and employers.
- [Поиск вакансий](https://vacancies.pikabu.ru/vacancies): Searchable catalog of current job openings.
- [Компании](https://vacancies.pikabu.ru/companies): Employer directory for browsing organizations posting jobs.
- [Категории вакансий](https://vacancies.pikabu.ru/categories): Job categories for filtering openings by profession or field.

## Education
- [Онлайн-курсы](https://education.pikabu.ru/): Course aggregator covering programming, analytics, design, and other skills.
- [Курсы программирования](https://education.pikabu.ru/programming): Programming course listings from partner education providers.
- [Курсы аналитики](https://education.pikabu.ru/analytics): Analytics and data-related course selection pages.
- [Курсы дизайна](https://education.pikabu.ru/design): Design education catalog for UI, graphic, and related disciplines.

## Games and Entertainment
- [Игры](https://games.pikabu.ru/): Browser games portal with casual, puzzle, and arcade titles.
- [Каталог игр](https://games.pikabu.ru/games): Browseable game directory across genres and formats.
- [Пополнить Steam](https://games.pikabu.ru/payment/steam): Steam wallet top-up page for supported payment flows.
- [Платежи](https://games.pikabu.ru/payment): Payment-related pages for gaming services and balances.

## Finance and Special Projects
- [Твои финансы](https://pikabu.ru/tvoi-finansy): Financial literacy project with articles and educational materials.
- [Финансовые материалы](https://pikabu.ru/tvoi-finansy/posts): Posts and guides focused on personal finance topics.
- [Спецпроекты](https://special.pikabu.ru/): Hub for Pikabu special projects, campaigns, and branded experiences.
